caption:
Instagram can now call your phone, through WhatsApp.

Meta is rolling out a setting that lets someone on your Instagram profile tap to call you on WhatsApp, using the number saved in your Accounts Center.

→ Off by default, you turn it on
→ Calls stay end-to-end encrypted
→ You choose who can call: everyone, contacts, or no one

Would you leave this on, or switch it to contacts-only? 👇

captions.facebook:
Instagram can now put your phone number to work.

Meta is rolling out a feature that lets people who find you on Instagram call you directly on WhatsApp, using the number linked in your Accounts Center. It's off by default, and you decide who's allowed: everyone, just your contacts, or no one at all.

The calls still run through WhatsApp's end-to-end encryption, so nothing changes there.

Have you checked your Accounts Center settings lately?

#instagram #whatsapp #socialmediatips

slides.title: Instagram can now ring your WhatsApp
slides.sub: A new setting connects your profile straight to a WhatsApp call.
slides.voiceover: Instagram can now make your WhatsApp ring, straight from your profile.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: WhatsApp calls on Instagram
items: What it does
Someone on your Instagram profile can tap to call you on WhatsApp
Where the number comes from
The phone number linked in your Meta Accounts Center
Default
Off, you turn it on yourself
Rollout
Gradually, over the coming months, not everyone has it yet
slides.voiceover: It uses the phone number linked in your Meta Accounts Center, and it's off by default.

slides.label: You stay in control
slides.title: Who can call you
items: Everyone
Any Instagram profile can start a WhatsApp call to you
Your contacts
Only people saved in your phone's contacts
No one
Keep the feature fully off
slides.voiceover: You pick who's allowed: everyone, just your contacts, or no one at all.

slides.label: Check your setting
slides.title: Where to find it
steps: Go to Accounts Center from your profile
Choose everyone, contacts, or no one
The setting applies the next time someone visits your profile
slides.voiceover: Check it in Accounts Center, under your linked WhatsApp account.

slides.label: Still private
slides.title: What doesn't change
items: Encryption
WhatsApp calls stay end-to-end encrypted either way
Messages
Your WhatsApp chats aren't affected by this setting
Linking
You need WhatsApp added to the same Accounts Center as Instagram
slides.voiceover: The calls are still end-to-end encrypted, nothing changes there.

slides.label: Worth knowing
slides.title: Before you turn it on
items: Set to "everyone" and any follower can call your number, not just message you
Requires WhatsApp linked in the same Accounts Center as your Instagram
Still rolling out, so it may not show up on your account yet
slides.cta: Set it to contacts-only for people you know.

slides.title: Your profile just got a phone line.
slides.title2: You decide who can dial it.
